Vākyāvalī
by Vāsudeva, grandson of Ṛṣiputra Parameśvara I of Payyūr Bhaṭṭatiri family. A poem in four sargas narrating the story of Lord Kṛṣṇa, brief notes given a. the end of each stanza indicating the Alaṅkāra, the metre an. the grammatical peculiarities. Each stanza begins with one of Vararuci's Sūtras which are intended for use in preparing a Hindu calendar.
